# `aitbc exchange order my`

Show this node's orders and next exchange nonce (read-only).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange order my [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet name (address only — no signing) |
| `--address` | text | — | no | Plain 0x address (no wallet needed) |
| `--exchange-url` | text | — | no | Override exchange service base URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange order my
```
